cmd.help_admin: Help: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD open, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD info, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD status, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD help, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD gatelist. Admin debug travel: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD dial <target> [source], /PH_PLUGIN_CMD warp <target gate>. New gate with ID, model and arrival point: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD placegate. Admin only: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD registerGate, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD unregisterGate <ID>, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD trust [UID]. Admin test: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD pack, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD unpack, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD recover. DHD management (admins): /PH_PLUGIN_CMD placedhd <ID>, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD removedhd <ID>, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD binddhd <ID>, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD unbinddhd, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD canceldhd. Passage zones (admins): /PH_PLUGIN_CMD sethorizon <ID> [X Y Z], /PH_PLUGIN_CMD showhorizon <ID>, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD removehorizon <ID>. Model preview: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD previewgate, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD clearpreview. Move existing gate model: /PH_PLUGIN_CMD placegate <ID>, /PH_PLUGIN_CMD removegatemodel <ID>. /PH_PLUGIN_CMD aligngate <ID>.

horizon.usage: Usage: /sg sethorizon <local gate> [X width Y height Z depth] (metres); /sg showhorizon <gate>; /sg removehorizon <gate>. /sg aligngate <ID>.
horizon.missing_gate: This local gate does not exist.
horizon.missing_zone: This gate has no passage zone yet.

horizon.near_gate: Stand within 16 metres of the local gate to set its passage zone.
horizon.overlap: The passage zone overlaps another gate zone. Choose another location or size.
horizon.saved: Passage zone saved at your feet (world axes X/Y/Z). Leave the zone before testing entry.
horizon.preview: Blue passage-zone preview visible to you for 30 seconds. Default size: X=3, Y=3, Z=1 metres; the floor includes 0.2 metres of tolerance.
horizon.database_error: Could not save the passage zone.
horizon.usage_align: /sg aligngate <gate ID>: Stand at the intended arrival position, centred 1–4 m in front of the gate model. Provide walkable ground there and through the gate.
horizon.edit_busy: Setup locked: the gate must be connected to the network and idle, with all transfers completed.
horizon.aligned_locked: This gate is aligned to its model. Explicitly remove its zone with /sg removehorizon <gate ID> before creating a free-standing zone.
horizon.missing_model: This gate has no permanent model yet. Use /sg placegate <gate ID> first.
horizon.arrival_front: The arrival point must be centred 1–4 m in front of the gate, at a height matching its opening. Stand on the intended ground/platform and repeat /sg aligngate <gate ID>.
horizon.sector_boundary: The arrival point would be in another sector. Choose a point in this gate's sector.
horizon.aligned: Gate aligned: your position is now the arrival point, facing out of the gate front. The circular passage follows the model; the old zone was replaced.
horizon.aligned_preview: The blue outline shows the rotated bounding frame of the opening for 30 seconds. The actual trigger is circular and checks the body centre, not the frame corners.
